correctness.rationale: Every solution is nilpotent with exactly one Jordan block length m+1 and all remaining blocks of length at most m. The endomorphism-ring/semisimple-quotient argument independently proves centralizer orders. Conjugation equivariance and orbit-stabilizer give exact integer multiplicities at each rank, with a constructive partition argument proving no rank gaps. The unique maximal-rank Jordan type has strictly largest conjugacy orbit and asymptotic root mass. An independent matrix-by-matrix verifier exhaustively checked eleven cases over q=2,3,4,5 including GF4 and all rank strata; these checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The nonzero minimal nilpotent orbit is the first natural singular stratum of the matrix power map. The theorem determines a complete exact rank-conditioned preimage distribution, possible ranks, and maximal-rank concentration for every dimension, exponent and finite field, extending root existence criteria to quantitative prescribed-target behavior. This natural invariant can benchmark enumerations for larger nilpotent targets; no general future theorem is assumed.
